notes: This contract pins the exact 2025 C++ declarations used by Umbra's bounded negotiated-divestiture Willing-to-Acquire slice: Negotiated Attribute Ownership Divestiture, Attribute Ownership Acquisition If Available, Request Divestiture Confirmation, Confirm Divestiture, and Attribute Ownership Acquisition Notification. Full owner search, arbitration, negotiated acquisition, RTI-owned state, and conformance remain open.
